2. Perform saccade testing to assess for hypometric or hypermetric saccades
3. Assess optokinetic nystagmus (OKN) response
4. Check convergence amplitude and facility
5. Test smooth pursuit movements
6. Perform the doll's head maneuver (vestibulo-ocular reflex)
7. Order MRI of the brain with attention to the brainstem and cerebellum
